name: identity
command: cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime; uname -a; cat /proc/cmdline; cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/online; cat /proc/1/wchan; timeout 5 systemctl --failed --no-pager

name: recovery-state
command: for n in watchdog soft_watchdog softlockup_panic panic watchdog_thresh; do echo $n; cat /proc/sys/kernel/$n; done; cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpuidle/current_driver

name: trace-state
command: cat /sys/kernel/tracing/current_tracer; cat /sys/kernel/tracing/tracing_on; cat /sys/kernel/tracing/set_event; cat /sys/kernel/tracing/trace_clock; cat /sys/kernel/tracing/buffer_size_kb; cat /sys/kernel/tracing/trace_options; cat /proc/sys/kernel/ftrace_dump_on_oops; cat /sys/module/rcupdate/parameters/rcu_cpu_stall_ftrace_dump; ls /sys/kernel/tracing/instances
